product.name: ByteCater
product.description: A centralized catering order management system that consolidates all catering orders into one platform to improve order accuracy and streamline communication.

product.name: BytePrep
product.description: A prep list and order guide optimization tool that helps restaurants reduce food waste and make smarter purchasing decisions.
